name: @stonedogcode/mobile-auth
description: Phone-side authentication helpers for Expo apps: PKCE for cross-device linking, and reading a 'connect a phone' QR or manual code. Pairs with @stonedogcode/auth on the server.
author: StoneDogCode L.L.C.
//exports: The Expo adapter is a separate entry point so the core never imports Expo: it stays testable in Node, and an app that brings its own CryptoPort never resolves expo-crypto.

scripts.gate: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run verify:package

//dependencies: None at runtime, deliberately. This sits on the sign-in path of every app that adopts it, so it should be auditable in an afternoon; every dependency it takes, every consumer inherits.
//peerDependencies: expo-crypto is needed only by the ./expo entry point, so it is optional.
